grading_policy.correct: Every requested material fact is correct, resolved, and supported by the summary.
grading_policy.partial: At least one requested material fact is omitted or unresolved, without a material wrong ruling.
grading_policy.incorrect: At least one material wrong ruling or contradictory caveat, even if other content or the final number is right.
grading_policy.scope: Question wording determines requested facts. Contextual answer-key extras are not automatically required. Each answer is assessed on its own; reader support labels do not determine grades.
grading_policy.unsupported_guess: True when the answer asserts a material rule without support in the snapshot; contradictions are retained. Cautious support labels or unresolved caveats alone do not imply guessing.
